all8.statistic: Pooled credit difference; two timing repeats travel together with each speaker sign
all8.interpretation: Finite conditional sign-label diagnostic on these fixed paired outputs, not a randomized deployment/population test

confirmation6.statistic: Pooled credit difference; two timing repeats travel together with each speaker sign
confirmation6.interpretation: Finite conditional sign-label diagnostic on these fixed paired outputs, not a randomized deployment/population test

1.scope: Deterministic subset sensitivity, not a confidence interval

2.scope: Deterministic subset sensitivity, not a confidence interval

schema.credit: sum primary.dual_deadline_audio_credit_seconds; denominator=sum primary.offered_audio_seconds, full EOS tails retained
schema.speaker_pair: one complete utterance per prespecified speaker; two timing repeats remain together
schema.energy: sum existing common_external_energy.origin_to_confirmed_physical_model_drain.total_joules; both physical boards, not whole-host/GPU-active
schema.worker: sum unique completed worker_job_wall_seconds or abandoned end-begin; infer is nested and never added; absent aborted infer remains NA

gate_scope: Arithmetic provenance and scope only; not a new serving gate, randomized trial, or causal attribution of total energy to cancellation
